newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JUNINHO MOVE TO TOTTENHAM OUT OF QUESTION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUNINHO MOVE TO TOTTENHAM OUT OF QUESTION.

text.p: Relegated English club Middlesbrough were discussing several offers for talented Brazilian midfielder Juninho on Tuesday after a move to Tottenham Hotspur fell through.
Juninho was reported to be having talks with Middlesbrough chief executive Keith Lamb in a bid to speed up a possible transfer to Spanish side Atletico Madrid.
Club spokesman Mark Hooper refused to confirm that a meeting was taking place.

But he said: "After the offer from Tottenham fell through the club is now considering other offers. (Manager) Bryan Robson has accepted that he wants to leave. We are discussing the offers at the moment."
Speculation has mounted about Juninho's future since Middlesbrough were relegated from the premier league last season.
The Brazilian has repeatedly said he would prefer a move to Spain but, with two years remaining on his contract at Middlesbrough, the north-east club appear to hold the key to his future.
Middlesbrough agreed on a fee with Tottenham but the player, who joined the Middlesbrough in October 1995, could not agree terms.
Last week Atletico said they had signed Juninho. Recent Spanish reports suggested the club was likely to pay $20.1 million for the midfielder.
